# PiAPI

## Docs
- Get Started [PiAPI Documentation - AI Model APIs for Image, Video, Audio & LLM](https://piapi.ai/docs/overview.md): Explore PiAPI's public documentation for image, video, audio, and text APIs, including authentication, task workflows, outputs, and webhooks.
- Get Started [Quickstart - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/quickstart.md): Getting started quickly with the public API, including authentication, task submission, and result retrieval. Learn how to use PiAPI public APIs safely and effectively.
- Get Started [Build a Workflow with PiAPI - Developer Guide - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/piapi-make/make-insturcution.md): Learn how to connect public PiAPI API capabilities in a workflow, configure requests, and handle asynchronous results in an automation flow.
- [Endpoints](https://piapi.ai/docs/endpoints.md):

- Endpoints > Seedance [Private Asset Library - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedance-api/private-asset.md): Learn how to manage private assets in the public PiAPI workflow, including asset inputs, task processing, and result retrieval.
- Endpoints > Kling [Lipsync Video API Examples - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/lipsync-examples.md): Explore public examples for creating lipsync video tasks with PiAPI, including request inputs, task handling, and generated media results.
- Endpoints > Kling [Motion Brush Video API Example - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/motion-brush-examples.md): Learn how to use a motion brush video workflow with PiAPI, including request setup, asynchronous task polling, and output handling.
- Endpoints > Kling [Elements Video Generation API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/kling-elements.md): Create an elements-based video generation task with PiAPI using public inputs, asynchronous processing, and output retrieval.
- Endpoints > Kling [Effects Video Generation API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/kling-effects.md): Create an effects-based video generation task with PiAPI, then poll the task and retrieve the generated video output.
- Endpoints > Tools [File Upload API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/tools/file-upload.md): Upload files for use with public PiAPI workflows and prepare accessible inputs for asynchronous API tasks and generated results.

## API Docs
- Endpoints > Seedance [Seedance 2.5 - Seedance API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedance-api/seedance-25.md): Create a Seedance video from a text prompt or reference image via PiAPI's Seedance API; submit a generation task and poll for the output video (asynchronous, task-based).
- Endpoints > Seedance [Seedance 2 - Seedance API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedance-api/seedance-2.md): Create a Seedance video from a text prompt or reference image via PiAPI's Seedance API; submit a generation task and poll for the output video (asynchronous, task-based).
- Endpoints > Seedance [Video Watermark Remover - Seedance API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedance-api/video-watermark-remover.md): Remove the watermark from a Seedance generated video via PiAPI's Seedance API; submit a task and retrieve the clean output video (asynchronous).
- Endpoints > Seedance [Get Seedance Task - Seedance API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedance-api/get-task.md): Retrieve the status and result of a Seedance task by task ID via PiAPI's Seedance API (asynchronous task polling).
- Endpoints > Seedream [Seedream 5 - Seedream API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedream-api/seedream-5.md): Generate or edit images from text prompts and image inputs with the Seedream API on PiAPI; submit a task and retrieve the resulting image (asynchronous, task-based).
- Endpoints > Seedream [Get Seedream Task - Seedream API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/seedream-api/get-task.md): Retrieve the status and result of a Seedream task by task ID via PiAPI's Seedream API (asynchronous task polling).
- Endpoints > Byteaudio [Seed-audio - Seed Audio API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/byteaudio-api/seed-audio.md): Generate audio from text with the Seed Audio API on PiAPI; submit a task and retrieve the output audio (asynchronous, task-based).
- Endpoints > Byteaudio [Get Seed Audio Task - Seed Audio API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/byteaudio-api/get-task.md): Retrieve the status and result of a Seed Audio task by task ID via PiAPI's Seed Audio API (asynchronous task polling).
- Endpoints > Kling > Cancel Task [Cancel Kling Task - Kling API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/cancel-task.md): Cancel a running or queued Kling task by task ID via PiAPI's Kling API.
- Endpoints > Kling > Cancel Task [Cancel Kling Tasks - Kling API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/cancel-tasks.md): Cancel multiple running or queued Kling tasks in a single request via PiAPI's Kling API.
- Endpoints > Kling [Get Kling Task - Kling API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/get-task.md): Retrieve the status and result of a Kling task by task ID via PiAPI's Kling API (asynchronous task polling).
- Endpoints > Kling [Create Task - Kling API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/create-task.md): Create a Kling video from a text prompt or reference image via PiAPI's Kling API; submit a generation task and poll for the output video (asynchronous, task-based).
- Endpoints > Kling [Kling Virtual Try-On - Kling API - PiAPI docs](https://piapi.ai/docs/kling-api/virtual-try-on-api.md): Generate a virtual try-on image by fitting a garment onto a person image via PiAPI's Kling API; submit a task and retrieve the result (asynchronous).
